title: Lu-Zhou improved first-nine-round AES-192 T4 attack with a 2^-8 sequence fraction

target.description: First nine AES-192 rounds with whitening K0 and ciphertext x10=SR(y9) XOR K9. The source omits the last MixColumns without loss of generality. This is not the intermediate Rounds 3-11 interval.

setting.key_relation: One unknown AES-192 master key expanded by the standard schedule; every key-space partition used by a configuration is processed.
setting.key_population: general secret key; the source's weak-key approach is exhaustive sequential partitioning, not a promise restricting the target key
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen-plaintext structures of 2^32 blocks; tuning-dependent structure counts remain in the data coordinate and construction notes.
assumptions: The source's cost model equates one round with sixteen table lookups, hence a nine-round encryption with 144 lookups.
Differential enumeration uses an average-one-solution S-box/Super-Sbox model; no universal worst-case solution bound has been reproduced.
All per-partition work is aggregated over every partition; table reuse does not restrict the target key to a weak-key class.

time.note: Native aggregate or phase sum. A numeric aggregate absent from the source stays null. Setup is included in total time and must not be added twice.

data.note: 2^121 chosen plaintexts accompany the 2^-8 H* fraction. Do not mix these time/memory values with the full point's lower data.

memory.note: T4 is not fractioned in this point. Its 2^172.3 bytes dominate the reduced H* term 2^157 bytes.

preprocessing.note: This is the source's rounded aggregate setup. Global T4 setup 2^165.4 remains lower-order rather than being literally fractioned away. H* creation interleaves with online subattacks.

success.description: The source does not state a numerical complete-master-key recovery probability for this exact endpoint. Section3 about63% belongs ONLY to the rejected first-nine unstreamed fraction2^-12.2/2^125.2-data/2^191.6-time point, not the indexed full, fraction8 or fraction9.8 endpoints or the new corrected constructions. Expected one conforming pair, table fractions and wrong-sequence matches stay separate.

review.scope: Targeted exact-edition success audit of defining construction and parameter passages; not a new complete-paper/forward audit. Conditional subroutines, expected counts, local author models, sampling coverage and whole recovery are distinguished.

components.description: Source table fraction2^-8; Sections4.2/5.1: retaining only this fraction of sequence-generation parameters is distinct from exhaustive key-space partitioning. Per-parameter coverage under the source average/uniform-domain model only, not the probability of completing recovery after repeated online work.

PDF15 Section4.2:2^144 structured pairs times2^(-(3+12+3)*8) yields expected one matching pair. This single-pair source model is not the probability of at least one match. Sections4.3/5.1 retain the path.

Section5.1 uses at most2^160 sequence entries in H* for ONE fixed Theta partition, compared with a uniform unrelated256-bit sequence; the fractional point retains a2^-8 parameter subset. This per-partition count model is not a bound for all queries or recovery.

PDF20 Step6(b): Eq4 contributes a further8-bit key-consistency sieve after T4 lookup. The six-round variant preserves the same construction with the modified T4 representation. A local candidate filter, not the chance of true-key recovery.

limitations: Author-reported analytical estimate; no third-party attack implementation run.
